1	/**
2	 * pi-ai assistant event translation into the Harness streaming protocol.
3	 *
4	 * pi-ai tool-call arguments are parsed objects while the Harness keeps their
5	 * raw JSON representation. pi-ai also reports failures as terminal stream
6	 * events, which this module maps into Harness finish chunks.
7	 *
8	 * @module dsh-llm-pi-ai/stream
9	 */
10	
11	import { brandString } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-brand'
12	import { CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED_CODE, EMPTY_RESPONSE_CODE, isContextWindowExceededError, isQuotaExceededError, LlmError, QUOTA_EXCEEDED_CODE } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
13	import type { FinishReason, StreamChunk, TokenUsage, ToolCallId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
14	import { isContextOverflow } from '@earendil-works/pi-ai'
15	import type { AssistantMessage, AssistantMessageEvent, Usage as PiUsage } from '@earendil-works/pi-ai'
16	import { toPiReplayState } from './replay.ts'
17	
18	/**
19	 * Map pi-ai usage (reasoning folded into output by pi-ai).
20	 * @param usage - cumulative usage from the terminal pi-ai event.
21	 * @returns harness counts with pi-ai's exact total; cache fields appear only
22	 *   when non-zero (pi-ai reports zeros, not absence).
23	 */
24	export function mapUsage(usage: PiUsage): TokenUsage {
25	  return {
26	    inputTokens: usage.input,
27	    outputTokens: usage.output,
28	    totalTokens: usage.totalTokens,
29	    ...usage.cacheRead > 0 ? { cacheReadTokens: usage.cacheRead } : {},
30	    ...usage.cacheWrite > 0 ? { cacheWriteTokens: usage.cacheWrite } : {},
31	  }
32	}
33	
34	// XXX(pi-ai upstream): pi-ai flattens the caught error to `error.message`
35	// (api/anthropic-messages.js: `errorMessage = error instanceof Error ?
36	// error.message : JSON.stringify(error)`), discarding the original Error and its
37	// `cause` chain before it reaches us. undici carries the actionable transport
38	// detail on `cause` (e.g. `SocketError: other side closed`) but hands the fetch
39	// wrapper a bare `terminated`, so we are left pattern-matching terse words here.
40	// If pi-ai ever forwards the original Error (or a fetch/dispatcher hook that lets
41	// us capture the cause ourselves), classify on `code`/`cause` instead of text.
42	function classifyPiAiError(message: string): string {
43	  if (/\b(?:401|403)\b/.test(message)) return 'AUTH'
44	  if (isQuotaExceededError(message)) return QUOTA_EXCEEDED_CODE
45	  // Gateways such as OmniRoute report a brief credential cooldown without a
46	  // status code: `All credentials for model … are cooling down (reset after 5s)`.
47	  if (/\b429\b|rate.?limit|cooling down/i.test(message)) return 'RATE_LIMIT'
48	  // A rejected request body (gateway or provider size cap): resending the
49	  // same request cannot succeed, so it is invalid, not transient.
50	  if (/\b413\b|failed to buffer the request body:\s*length limit exceeded|payload too large|request body too large/i.test(message)) return 'INVALID_REQUEST'
51	  if (/\b400\b|invalid.?request/i.test(message)) return 'INVALID_REQUEST'
52	  if (/\b5\d\d\b/.test(message)) return 'SERVER'
53	  if (/\btime(?:d)?\s*out\b|timeout/i.test(message)) return 'TIMEOUT'
54	  // A stream truncated before the provider's terminal event: each pi-ai provider
55	  // throws its own wording when the wire closes mid-response without a terminal
56	  // event (`… stream ended before message_stop`, `… before a terminal response
57	  // event`, `… ended without a terminal event`, `Stream ended without
58	  // finish_reason`). The connection dropped mid-response, so this is a transport
59	  // truncation, not a model-level error.
60	  if (/stream ended (?:before|without)\b/i.test(message)) return 'TRANSPORT'
61	  if (/\b(?:network|connection|socket|fetch)\b|\bECONN[A-Z]+\b/i.test(message)
62	    || /\b(?:other side closed|HTTP2 request did not get a response|WebSocket closed unexpectedly)\b/i.test(message)
63	    // undici renders a mid-stream socket drop as a bare `terminated` (its
64	    // `cause` — the real SocketError — was flattened away upstream); Node's
65	    // stream layer says `Premature close`.
66	    || /\bterminated\b|premature close/i.test(message)) {
67	    return 'TRANSPORT'
68	  }
69	  return 'PI_AI_ERROR'
70	}
71	
72	/**
73	 * Map a terminal pi-ai event to the harness finish reason.
74	 * @param message - the assistant message carried by the `done` or `error` event.
75	 * @param contextWindow - resolved catalog capacity for usage-based overflow detection.
76	 * @returns the mapped harness reason. Recognized error text, `stop` usage above
77	 *   `contextWindow`, and zero-output `length` usage that fills the window map
78	 *   to `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`; a `stop` with no content blocks maps to an
79	 *   `EMPTY_RESPONSE` error, while terminal `pending` and `deferred` states map
80	 *   to non-retryable `PI_AI_ERROR` failures.
81	 */
82	export function mapStopReason(message: AssistantMessage, contextWindow?: number): FinishReason {
83	  const piAiOverflow = isContextOverflow(message, contextWindow)
84	  const harnessOverflow = message.stopReason === 'error'
85	    && message.errorMessage !== undefined
86	    && isContextWindowExceededError(message.errorMessage)
87	  if (piAiOverflow || harnessOverflow) {
88	    return {
89	      kind: 'error',
90	      failure: {
91	        message: message.errorMessage ?? `pi-ai detected context overflow for model "${message.model}"`,
92	        code: CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED_CODE,
93	      },
94	    }
95	  }
96	
97	  switch (message.stopReason) {
98	    case 'stop':
99	      // A terminal stop that produced no content blocks is a degenerate
100	      // provider completion, not a successful (empty) assistant message.
101	      if (message.content.length === 0) {
102	        return {
103	          kind: 'error',
104	          failure: {
105	            message: `model "${message.model}" returned a completed response with no content`,
106	            code: EMPTY_RESPONSE_CODE,
107	          },
108	        }
109	      }
110	      return { kind: 'stop' }
111	    case 'length': return { kind: 'max-tokens' }
112	    case 'toolUse': return { kind: 'tool-calls' }
113	    case 'pending': return {
114	      kind: 'error',
115	      failure: { message: `pi-ai stream for model "${message.model}" ended pending`, code: 'PI_AI_ERROR' },
116	    }
117	    case 'deferred': return {
118	      kind: 'error',
119	      failure: { message: `pi-ai deferred response for model "${message.model}" is not supported`, code: 'PI_AI_ERROR' },
120	    }
121	    case 'aborted': return {
122	      kind: 'aborted',
123	      failure: { message: message.errorMessage ?? 'pi-ai stream aborted', code: 'ABORTED' },
124	    }
125	    case 'error': {
126	      const text = message.errorMessage ?? 'pi-ai stream error'
127	      return { kind: 'error', failure: { message: text, code: classifyPiAiError(text) } }
128	    }
129	  }
130	}
131	
132	/**
133	 * Translate the pi-ai event stream into StreamChunks. pi-ai never throws
134	 * mid-stream — failures arrive as `error` events, which become error/aborted
135	 * `finish` chunks (the harness protocol's other error-delivery style).
136	 * @param events - one assistant turn's pi-ai event stream.
137	 * @param contextWindow - resolved catalog capacity for usage-based overflow detection.
138	 * @param callerSignal - caller cancellation state; an aborted caller makes any
139	 *   in-band terminal error an aborted finish.
140	 * @returns the harness chunks, ending with `usage` then `finish`; throws
141	 *   `LlmError` (`STREAM_CLOSED`) if the source ends without a terminal event.
142	 */
143	export async function* toStreamChunks(
144	  events: AsyncIterable<AssistantMessageEvent>,
145	  contextWindow?: number,
146	  callerSignal?: AbortSignal,
147	): AsyncGenerator<StreamChunk> {
148	  // pi-ai contentIndex ↔ our block index map 1:1 (both count blocks from 0
149	  // in stream order), but we track ids per index for tool calls.
150	  const toolIds = new Map<number, { id: string; name: string }>()
151	
152	  for await (const event of events) {
153	    switch (event.type) {
154	      case 'start':
155	        break
156	      case 'text_start':
157	        yield { type: 'block-start', index: event.contentIndex, blockType: 'text' }
158	        break
159	      case 'text_delta':
160	        yield { type: 'text-delta', index: event.contentIndex, text: event.delta }
161	        break
162	      case 'text_end':
163	        yield { type: 'block-end', index: event.contentIndex, block: { type: 'text', text: event.content } }
164	        break
165	      case 'thinking_start':
166	        yield { type: 'block-start', index: event.contentIndex, blockType: 'reasoning' }
167	        break
168	      case 'thinking_delta':
169	        yield { type: 'reasoning-delta', index: event.contentIndex, text: event.delta }
170	        break
171	      case 'thinking_end':
172	        yield { type: 'block-end', index: event.contentIndex, block: { type: 'reasoning', text: event.content } }
173	        break
174	      case 'toolcall_start': {
175	        // The id/name live on the partial's content at this index.
176	        const partial = event.partial.content[event.contentIndex]
177	        const id = partial?.type === 'toolCall' ? partial.id : ''
178	        const name = partial?.type === 'toolCall' ? partial.name : ''
179	        toolIds.set(event.contentIndex, { id, name })
180	        yield { type: 'block-start', index: event.contentIndex, blockType: 'tool-call' }
181	        break
182	      }
183	      case 'toolcall_delta': {
184	        const known = toolIds.get(event.contentIndex)
185	        yield {
186	          type: 'tool-call-delta',
187	          index: event.contentIndex,
188	          id: brandString<ToolCallId>(known?.id ?? ''),
189	          ...known?.name !== undefined && known.name.length > 0 ? { name: known.name } : {},
190	          argumentsDelta: event.delta,
191	        }
192	        break
193	      }
194	      case 'toolcall_end':
195	        yield {
196	          type: 'block-end',
197	          index: event.contentIndex,
198	          block: {
199	            type: 'tool-call',
200	            id: brandString<ToolCallId>(event.toolCall.id),
201	            name: event.toolCall.name,
202	            // pi-ai hands back the PARSED arguments; the harness vocabulary
203	            // keeps the raw string.
204	            arguments: JSON.stringify(event.toolCall.arguments),
205	          },
206	        }
207	        break
208	      case 'done':
209	        yield { type: 'usage', usage: mapUsage(event.message.usage) }
210	        yield {
211	          type: 'finish',
212	          reason: mapStopReason(event.message, contextWindow),
213	          replayState: toPiReplayState(event.message),
214	        }
215	        return
216	      case 'error':
217	        // In-stream error delivery (pi-ai's style) → error finish chunk
218	        // (the harness's other sanctioned error path besides throwing).
219	        yield { type: 'usage', usage: mapUsage(event.error.usage) }
220	        yield {
221	          type: 'finish',
222	          reason: mapStopReason(
223	            callerSignal?.aborted ? { ...event.error, stopReason: 'aborted' } : event.error,
224	            contextWindow,
225	          ),
226	        }
227	        return
228	      // no default: AssistantMessageEvent is pi-ai's closed union; a new
229	      // event type should fail compilation here via tsc's exhaustiveness
230	      // when one is added (switch covers all current variants).
231	    }
232	  }
233	  throw new LlmError('pi-ai event stream ended without done/error', 'STREAM_CLOSED')
234	}
